title: Version the wire surface before anyone freezes it
description:
UPSTREAM.md states the problem and does not schedule it: "The hire claim
block and the hire_ audience namespace are today changeable at will.
Under a graduated project's stability rules they would not be. The HKDF
scheme label is already versioned for this reason (hire-pseudonym-v1:);
the rest of the wire surface is not, and should be before it matters."

"Before it matters" is a date set by the first integrator, not by us.

WHAT IS UNVERSIONED TODAY:

* the hire claim block inside the JWT-SVID: sources, auth_methods,
  identity_assurance, presence and whatever joins them
* the hire_ audience parameter namespace: hire_max_age today, and
  hire_min_assurance is already filed as persona-ouo5.3
* the hint tag grammar: source, identity_assurance, presence, age.
  SvidHint's parser already refuses unknown keys, which is the strict
  half of a compatibility rule with no other half

WHAT IS VERSIONED: the pseudonym scheme label, hire-pseudonym-v1:. It is
versioned because changing the derivation silently re-homes every
consumer's view of the user, which is a failure loud enough to have been
imagined in advance. The rest fails quietly, which is why it was not.

THE DECISION, which is the work and is cheaper than the mechanism: one
version for the whole extension surface or one per surface. A single
hire_version is a constraint -- everything moves together, a consumer
branches once. Per-surface versions are a mechanism, and buy independent
evolution nobody has asked for.

THEN THE OTHER HALF OF THE RULE: what a consumer does with a version it
does not know. SvidHint refuses unknown keys today, which is right for a
tag a consumer may ignore entirely and wrong as a general policy: a
claim block that refuses to parse on an unknown minor version cannot
ever be extended. The likely shape is that unknown fields within a known
major version are ignored and an unknown major version means the claim
block is not read at all.

Do this while the only consumer is our own test suite.
acceptance_criteria: Every extension hire adds to a JWT-SVID carries a version its consumer can branch on, and a documented rule for what a consumer does with a version it does not recognise.
